date.as_written: śrīvikrama samvat 1917 sālam iti vaiśāṣavadi 12 roja3

purpose: for the collection (saṃgraha) of prince Upendravikramasāhadeva
notes: The catalogue lists Upendra Vikrama Sāhadeva under King, but the colophon calls him rājakumāra (prince). He was a younger son of King Rājendra and brother of the reigning King Surendravikramasāhadeva, who is not named in the colophon. 'idaṃ pustakaṃ ... saṃgrahaṃ' says the book belongs to his collection, so his role is owner. No scribe is named. 'roja 3' is taken as Tuesday (counting Sunday as roja 1). VS 1917 Vaiśākha falls in April–May 1860 CE.
